title: IstanbulDistrictRegistry
description: The single authoritative Istanbul district catalog (docs/adr/0003-phase2-checkpoint-c0-serving-contract.md §5, added in Checkpoint C.0.1). No prior Phase 1 district catalog contract existed -- this is a new, small, committed aggregate derived 1:1 from services/travel-mcp/phase2/data_pipeline/side_mapping.py's accepted 39-district side mapping (25 European + 14 Asian, fixed public administrative geography, not learned or dataset-derived). The canonical instance IS contracts/examples/valid/IstanbulDistrictRegistry.json -- not merely a validation fixture; SearchStaysRequest.district_ids and search_stays's future UNKNOWN_DISTRICT check are validated against that exact file, so there is one authoritative registry, never a duplicated or conflicting second list. side uses the uppercase canonical values EUROPEAN/ASIAN; StayOption.side (contracts/StayOption.schema.json, already-accepted Phase 1 contract) separately uses lowercase european/asian for the wire payload -- the deterministic normalization rule is side.lower(), documented here so the two never silently drift.

district_id.description: ASCII-normalized, matches StayOption.district_id and side_mapping.py's own ASCII-transliterated table entries (e.g. 'Besiktas' -> district_besiktas).

canonical_name.description: Correct Turkish Unicode spelling, current official name.
